## 1. Professional Overview
Nima Hosseini (WVRNER) is a Cloud and DevOps Engineer specializing in declarative AWS infrastructure, reproducible Terraform environments, automated GitHub Actions pipelines with OIDC federation, and resilient Linux systems.

- Website: https://wvrner.com

## 2. Technical Disciplines & Core Stack
1. Cloud Infrastructure: AWS Core Topology (VPC, IAM Least-Privilege, ECS Fargate, S3, CloudFront, Route 53).
2. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, State Locking with S3/DynamoDB, Automated Drift Detection, Modular Workspaces.
3. Continuous Delivery & Automation: GitHub Actions, AWS OIDC Authentication (Zero Long-Lived Secrets), Automated Smoke and Canary Tests.
4. Systems & Container Runtime: Linux Kernel Invariants, Docker Multi-Stage Builds, Minimal Attack Surface Distroless Images.
5. Reliability & Networking: Zero-downtime Blue/Green deployments, health checks, TLS termination, DNS failover.
